entities.summary: Jozef Obert, nicknamed Joschi during his career in Austria, was a Slovak football forward and later coach. He played for Slovan Bratislava, Rudá Hvězda Brno, Tatran Prešov and Wacker Innsbruck. He scored 92 goals at the Czechoslovak First League. He died 18 October 2020 in Bratislava.
